dedupe_keys.name: rete ciclabile ed escursionistica esistente e pianificata 2019 comune di lecce

description: The Municipality of Lecce publishes its existing and planned cycling and hiking network for 2019. The Mobility Office and Park Office produced the resource with a consultant identified in the metadata. It includes route geometries, points of interest and project documents. A Shapefile package uses EPSG:32633, and the existing-network GeoJSON is explicitly supplied in EPSG:4326. Separate GeoJSON entries identify the proposed network and points of interest. The spatial data can define existing links and proposed additions in active-mobility network simulations. A caveat is that a planned route must not be treated as an operating connection. The description does not give positional accuracy, network connectivity checks or confirmation that projects were constructed. Access is public and free under Creative Commons Attribution, with an unspecified version. The related older 2011 Lecce cycle-plan dataset may overlap this release, but equivalence of the two inventories is unresolved; it is not counted as another new addition here.
